notes: Building and Engineering News, vol. 30 part 2 (Internet Archive buildingengineer30230cont), the 26 weekly issues from 5 July to 27 December 1930. Same method as the earlier volumes: every numbered entry under Building Permit Applications and Building Contracts was taken from the djvu.xml OCR, East Bay headings set aside, and each San Francisco lot built from the block corner on the DPW street centrelines and compared with the sf-parcels shapes; a placement was accepted where the lot starts within two feet of a lot line of today (or the record names an unambiguous corner) and the roll dates the building 1929-1932, and alterations were matched by printed street number in sf-eas-addresses where the roll dates the building before 1930. Every published row was read against the page image, location first; 91 of the 110 rows read needed a name, a cost or the wording corrected, and a cost or name that could not be read on the image was left out. Where a permit and its contract appear in the same issue the page carries one entry and the contract finding is held. Descriptions of rows marked confidence low were built from the OCR and have not been read against the image. Owners are private individuals and are cut everywhere (raw.note); a firm or institution named as owner is kept, and where the contractor or architect named is the owner or shares the owner's surname that name is cut too. Sub-trade contracts are timeline entries and set no builder credit. Completion notices, liens, sub-contracts printed 'on above' and the news columns were not taken. Issue dates are set from the 26 cover pages, listed by hand (the cover-line reader missed the 1 November and 27 December covers), one week apart from 5 July. A permit for a row of houses is published only where the page says which lot it is; two such rows were held.

coverage.remaining: Vols. 26 to 30 read (January 1926 to December 1930); the other 24 half-year volumes (1915 to January 1932) are unread, vol. 31 part 1 (January-June 1931, buildingengineer3131cont) next. In this volume: 156 rows placed on a parcel whose roll year fits, all single houses with no architect named and no page, are logged and held until another fact gives the parcel a page (extra.placed_apn; they still need the image check). 234 rows have a nearest parcel that was not accepted (the lot starts off today's lot lines, or the roll dates the building outside the window). 491 rows were not placed: 212 location lines not parsed (tract lots, garbled headings), 99 street pairs that do not cross under the names read (OCR spellings, renamed streets) and 180 printed street numbers with no EAS row today.
coverage.note: 1,529 numbered entries read, 991 San Francisco rows, 500 placed on a parcel, 110 picked and read against the page image, 99 published on 96 pages (44 seeded), 11 held back: two same-issue contracts merged into the permit entry, six uses or storey counts that contradict the roll, two permits for a row of houses placed on one lot only, and one parcel with no address row.
